title: Wind load source
description: Woodcore-Datei/loads/wind/<id>.json -- one building whose wind Woodcore computes from SIA 261:2020 chapter 6 and Annexe C (calc/domains/wind_source.py, docs/domain/loads.md §3.3quater, issue #37). Read beside the WL-* sheets of a load workbook, under the same domain wind-load; an id both carry is refused.

schema_version.description: -- pinned. 1.1 (issue #42): 1.0 with `links`, written only where a field follows a variable.

q_p0.description: The reference dynamic pressure at the site, SIA 261 Annexe E, kN/m².

terrain.description: The terrain category of SIA 261 Tableau 4.

b.description: The building's dimension across the wind direction φ = 0°, m.

z.description: The height above ground the dynamic pressure is taken at, m; null takes h (6.2.2.3).

table.description: The table of SIA 261 Annexe C whose coefficients the building takes: 31 to 56, 57a to 57d, 58, 59a, 59b, 60a, 60b, 63, 64.

c_d.description: The dynamic factor, 1.0 for the buildings of SIA 261 6.3.5, else SIA 261/1's.

links.description: The fields of this entry that follow a variable of the export, by their key (q_p0, b, d, h, z, c_d): the number the field holds is the last value known, which a variable that can no longer be read leaves in place with a warning (D-06). Absent where none follows one; only at schema_version 1.1.

.*.description: A variable of the export this field follows (calc/domains/links.py, spec 2026-10-11-variables-liees-champs-et-textes D-17): the pair a call names its calculation by and its key -- a domain of the «Formule» tab carries origin "formulas" and its id as instance --, with an optional factor and offset (factor × variable + offset).
